user.title: Set up Hungarian Energy Tariffs
user.description: Select the Home Assistant energy sensor to track and give this configuration a name. Prefer a lifetime total sensor (state class "total", never resets) if you have one; a daily-resetting sensor ("total_increasing") also works correctly.

distribution_area.title: Distribution area
distribution_area.description: Your bill states this directly - look for "Elosztói engedélyes" (distribution licensee). You can also cross-check against the [official MVM price sheet]({price_sheet_url}), which is organized by DSO area.

tariff_energy_prices.title: Electricity price
tariff_energy_prices.description: Villamosenergia ár - net (VAT-excluded) Ft/kWh, matching your bill's "ESZ Lakossági 'A1' kedv./piaci ár" lines. Verify against the [official MVM price sheet]({price_sheet_url}).

tariff_network_fees.title: Network usage fees
tariff_network_fees.description: Rendszerhasználati díjak - matches your bill's "Elosztói forgalmi díj", "Átvételi forgalmi díj", and "Elosztói alapdíj" lines.

data.fixed_monthly_fee_ft: Elosztói alapdíj / fixed monthly fee (Ft, gross)
